requirement: Pressing `a` MUST open an add-forward dialog. The dialog MUST let the user select an SSH host name discovered from the user's SSH configuration (for example, `chronos` or `mnemosyne`), enter a remote port, and select exactly one of the offered radio-style local-port choices with the keyboard. Confirming the dialog MUST create the selected port forward and add it to the table.
rationale: The pfm binary currently only prints Hello, world!. Implement the add-forward dialog, host and port entry, radio choices, and forward creation.
